description:
Make your phone louder. Volume booster for speakers, videos and calls. No ads. Decibel is a simple volume booster that makes quiet videos, calls, music and speakers louder. No ads, no tracking, no internet permission. Turn it on, slide the boost up, and it raises the sound of every app using Android's built-in loudness effect.
  • One big on/off button and a Quick Settings tile
  • Volume and Boost sliders on one screen
  • Up to +12 dB, or +24 dB with Higher boost
  • Runs in the background with a notification to stop it
  • No ads, no tracking, no internet permission
Loud sound can damage speakers and hearing. Turn the boost down if you hear crackling.
